1.0.0.en: First release. Monitor Cummins home standby generators from Homey — via Cummins Connect Cloud, or locally over your LAN for older RS-series models with the web-interface card. Start, stop and exercise the generator from the device tile or a Flow, with alarms for faults, missed self-tests and a generator that has stopped checking in. Includes Insights on every value, a dashboard widget, and estimated power output and energy produced. Unofficial community app, not affiliated with Cummins Inc.
